module: Toolbox of the rally note compositor. Walks the elements of a structured note in the fixed order of the slots, calls the active style's componentTypes registry rules for each type (corner, caution, modifiers), and produces the phrases (with category and variant), adding the before/after distance markers. It also contains range lookups (intensity by diameter, length by arc length), the phrase hash used as the audio file name, and the phrase enumerations for audio generation and the script player. Unknown types or non-renderable values are silently ignored.
notes: A range is {min, max} with optional max (last range open-ended); rangeContains tests min <= v < max.
Intensity lists go from highest to lowest risk: a positive riskIntensity moves toward the start of the list (index - step, clamped).
A corner's descriptor takes precedence over intensity; in that case the length is not spoken.
Corner direction: -1 left, 1 right, 0/nil = no corner call. lengthMode can be 'skip', 'shorter' or 'longer'.
Phrase categories: distance, linkword, corner, caution, modifier, other. A distance text equal to a style link is classified as 'linkword'.
pacenoteHash: lowercase, apostrophes removed, every character outside a-z0-9 replaced by '_', repeated '_' merged, leading/trailing '_' removed; used to name audio files.
getRandomWeightedItem uses math.random: non-deterministic result; the default weight is 1.
enumerateScriptEntries and enumerateConcise receive a textCompositor parameter that is unused.

getNearestValue.desc: Returns the entry whose numeric value ('value' key by default) is closest to targetValue.

rangeBounds.desc: Reads a range {min, max}: returns numeric min and max (max nil if absent); nil, nil if value is not a table.

rangeContains.desc: True if targetValue is in [min, max[ (or >= min without max).

getRangeValue.desc: Returns the first entry whose range ('value' key by default) contains targetValue.

getClosestEntry.desc: Returns the entry whose range is closest to targetValue (distance 0 if contained), with optional filter.

cornerNumbering.desc: Returns the numbering sub-table of a corner component (cornerCfg.numbering, or cornerCfg itself if it does not exist, or {} if nil).

cornerIntensityList.desc: Ordered list of the style's corner intensities.

cornerLengthList.desc: List of corner lengths for an intensity (lengthsByIntensity[intensityId]).

cornerLengthEntryById.desc: Finds a length entry by its id for an intensity.

modifierComponents.desc: Table of the style's atomic modifiers (componentTypes.modifiers, or {}).

lookupComponentType.desc: Returns the component config for an element type: corner and caution directly, otherwise a modifier (resolving modifierAliases).

cornerLengthEntryText.desc: Spoken text of a length entry.

cornerLengthEntryLabel.desc: Label of a length entry: label, otherwise text, otherwise id.

intensityEntryText.desc: Spoken text of an intensity entry.

intensityEntryLabel.desc: Label of an intensity entry: label, otherwise text, otherwise id.

signedStep.desc: Sign of a value: 1, -1 or 0 (0 if non-numeric).

lookupIntensityEntry.desc: Intensity entry of the style matching a measured physical diameter ('diameter' range).

lookupRiskAdjustedIntensityEntry.desc: Like lookupIntensityEntry on item.intensity, then shifts the entry according to the sign of item.riskIntensity (positive = toward the start of the list, riskier), clamped at the ends.

lookupDescriptorEntry.desc: Descriptor entry of a corner (cornerCfg.descriptors, resolving descriptorAliases).

getCornerCall.desc: Corner call phrase: descriptor + direction, otherwise intensity (risk-adjusted) + direction + afterDirection. Returns nil if there is no direction, the direction is not defined in the style, or the intensity is not found.

getCornerLengthForIntensity.desc: Corner length text for a given intensity based on item.arcMeters; lengthMode 'shorter'/'longer' shifts by one entry, 'skip' removes it.

getCornerLengthForItem.desc: Corner length text, first looking up the element's intensity (without risk adjustment).

getCornerShape.desc: Spoken text of a corner's shape.

postProcessPhrase.desc: Cleans up a phrase (removes leading and trailing spaces via rallyUtil.trimString).

pacenoteHash.desc: Turns a phrase into an identifier usable as a file name (see notes).

returns.desc: Hash, nil if text is nil.

getRandomWeightedItem.desc: Randomly picks an item according to its 'weight' field (1 by default).

distanceCallsEnabled.desc: True unless config.distance.callsEnabled is explicitly false.

compositePhraseEntries.desc: Walks the structured elements in the fixed order of the slots, calls the type's emitter and adds the before/after distance markers. Elements are spoken one after another with no automatic connector; links between notes ('into', 'and') come from the distance link list if distance calls are enabled.

opts.desc: escapeVars (boolean: variables instead of values), variantResolver (function(entry) -> entry|nil), distanceAfterBeforePostModifier (boolean: places the after-distance before the first modifier that follows the corner).

compositeFromPhrases.desc: Simplified version of compositePhraseEntries that returns only the texts.

enumerateScriptEntries.desc: Enumerates the script player entries with category, subcategory, variant and sort keys: distance links, corner calls (by intensity and direction), descriptors, lengths, shapes, caution levels, modifiers. Richer than enumerateConcise.

returns.desc: Entries {phrase, hash, audioFname, recordingSlug, category, subcategory, sourceContext, variant, sortGroup, sortSubgroup, sortPhrase}.

enumerateConcise.desc: Enumerates all speakable phrases of the active style (deduplicated): distance links, corner calls, descriptors, lengths, shapes, cautions, modifiers. Used by the audio pipeline and the script player to know which files to look for or generate.
